title: Challenge Management
desc: Manage CTF, Theory, ISW, AWD, and AWD+ challenges, score values, and environment configs.
ctf_desc: Create and configure Web, Pwn, Reverse, Crypto, and Misc jeopardy challenges, attachments, and Flags.
theory_desc: Manage single choice, multiple choice, true/false, and QA questions for cybersecurity fundamentals.
isw_desc: Manage Industrial Security Workshop (ISW) challenges, ICS targets, and network topologies.
awd_desc: Manage Attack & Defense target container images, SLA health checks, and automated scoring targets.
awd_plus_desc: Manage advanced AWD Plus multi-service target architectures, SLA checks, and automated defense metrics.
